subject: Subcontracting chain notice — EdgeLogix onboarding & DPA addendum
messages:
From: Amelia Tan <amelia@cloudatlas.io>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeLogix Onboarding <onboard@edgelogix.net>
Date: 2028-09-11 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: EdgeLogix subcontracting for ingestion pipeline + DPA addendum

Hi Priyom,

Per our onboarding plan, CloudAtlas will engage EdgeLogix to provide real-time log ingestion and transient buffering for the Redwood integration. EdgeLogix will have scoped access to telemetry and non-PI customer identifiers strictly for ingestion and normalization; they will not receive downstream generated content.

We've attached the formal subcontracting notice and an EdgeLogix-proposed DPA addendum (redlines included). Key asks from our side:
- Confirmation that Redwood consents to the subprocessor and that the data access scope is acceptable
- Any additional security or contractual flow-down clauses Redwood requires (encryption, attestations, right to audit, breach notification SLAs)
- Order form amendment to reflect the subprocessor (we've linked the current order form in the attachment)

Can you route this to your legal/procurement folks and loop in any required sign-off? We're targeting final execution by the end of next week to avoid delaying the pilot.

Thanks — happy to take a 30-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Amelia
Amelia Tan
Sr. Procurement Manager, CloudAtlas

Date: 2028-09-11 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Notice: EdgeLogix subcontracting for ingestion pipeline + DPA addendum

Team — forwarding CloudAtlas's notice. Short background: CloudAtlas is our early pilot customer for low-latency log-based telemetry; they want EdgeLogix in the stack for ingestion. The external materials are attached.

Immediate asks for us:
1) Legal redline review of EdgeLogix DPA addendum for flow-down coverage (encryption at rest/in transit, KMS, deletion/return, subprocessor cascade clause).
2) Procurement: confirm whether we require additional vetting (SOC2 Type II, ISO27001, or an on-site assessment) given EdgeLogix will handle telemetry logs.
3) Ops/Engineering (Jonas): short technical write-up on what data fields EdgeLogix will see and retention windows.

Please assign owners and I'll coordinate CloudAtlas timeline.

Thanks,
Priyom
Business Development Manager | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-11 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: EdgeLogix subcontracting for ingestion pipeline + DPA addendum

Thanks Priyom — reviewing now. Quick notes from a legal perspective after a first pass of the redline:
- Flow-down: EdgeLogix proposes a fairly narrow flow-down, but they're missing explicit audit rights and a requirements clause for SOC2 evidence. We should add a clause that allows Redwood (and where contractually required, the customer) to request SOC2 reports or equivalent within a defined SLA (10 business days).
- Encryption/KMS: redline requests server-side encryption only. We should insist on TLS1.2+ in transit and AES-256 at rest, and require proof of key management controls (e.g., KMS or HSM).
- Deletion & data returns: their deletion timeframe is 90 days; propose 30 days for telemetry to align with our retention policy for pilot customers.
- Sub-subprocessors: add a requirement for CloudAtlas/Redwood notice + consent for any subsequent subprocessor change that affects data residency or materially expands scope.

I'll produce a marked-up document with proposed language and reference clauses from our standard MSA. Marissa — can you run the proposed language against the Order Form pricing/limits (if we shorten retention there, any cost impact?)

Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-09-12 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: EdgeLogix subcontracting for ingestion pipeline + DPA addendum

Looping in procurement notes after quick check with finance:
- Changing retention from 90 -> 30 days for ingestion will not materially change pricing for the pilot (data volume is small). We can absorb the change for contractual alignment, but if CloudAtlas requests longer retention later, we'll need a price tier.
- Verification: EdgeLogix is not in our approved vendor list. We should request their latest SOC2 report and a completed security questionnaire before consenting.
- Order form amendment: I'll draft an order form exhibit that lists EdgeLogix as an approved subprocessor for the CloudAtlas engagement and references the DPA addendum.

I'll prepare the procurement checklist and request the SOC2 evidence from Amelia.

Marissa
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Tan <amelia@cloudatlas.io>
Date: 2028-09-12 13:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: EdgeLogix subcontracting for ingestion pipeline + DPA addendum

Amelia / team — technical scope from Ops: what EdgeLogix will see is limited to: timestamp, PID-hash (pseudonymized), service identifier, and status codes. No user-generated prompts or model outputs. Retention in the ingestion buffer is currently set to 48 hours in their ingestion tier; the proposed 90-day retention in the redline is for their historical analytics product and is not needed for the pilot.

We recommend (a) contractual prohibition on using telemetry for profiling without consent, and (b) limit storage to 30 days for any logs handed back to EdgeLogix.

I can prepare a short statement of technical scope and an architecture diagram for legal/procurement to attach to the order form exhibit.

Jonas
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Tan <amelia@cloudatlas.io>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-13 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: EdgeLogix subcontracting for ingestion pipeline + DPA addendum — Redwood comments and next steps

Amelia — thanks for the materials and for flagging the target timeline. Attached is our consolidated set of comments (redline) and a short exhibit describing the technical scope we plan to append to the Order Form. Summary of proposed changes:
- Consent: Redwood will conditionally approve the subprocessor for the CloudAtlas engagement pending receipt of EdgeLogix SOC2 Type II report and confirmation of KMS controls.
- Audit rights: add a clause allowing Redwood (and where required, CloudAtlas) to request SOC2 evidence within 10 business days and, in escalations, to engage a third-party assessor (costs borne by CloudAtlas unless the issue is Redwood-originated).
- Encryption: require TLS1.2+ and AES-256 at rest; key management proof (KMS/HSM) required prior to go-live.
- Retention: change the EdgeLogix retention clause to 30 days for ingestion/storage related to Redwood/CloudAtlas traffic, with an option to extend by mutual written agreement and pricing appendix.
- Sub-subprocessors: require 30-day notice and explicit consent for any change that affects EU/US data residency or broadens the scope.

Next steps I propose:
1) Amelia/CloudAtlas to obtain and share EdgeLogix SOC2 report and KMS documentation.
2) EdgeLogix to accept Redwood's redline or propose targeted counterlanguage on audit logistics.
3) Marissa to share the procurement checklist and updated Order Form exhibit for signature.

If CloudAtlas agrees to the items above, we aim to sign the DPA addendum and amend the Order Form within 4 business days of receiving the SOC2 evidence.

Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
